Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with 3 days of diarrhea.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Loose, watery stools 6–7 times per day for 3 days.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Left lower abdominal cramping associated with diarrhea.
Patient reports weakness and feeling shaky.
Fever occurred around symptom onset 3–4 days ago but is not present currently.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Vomiting occurred at symptom onset but has resolved.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Possible trigger identified as Chinese takeaway approximately 4 days ago.
